name: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
description: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat and place your hands lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows angled slightly forward, then open them out while gently drawing your shoulder blades together.
Let your chest open without arching your lower back.
